event_summary: A brown oblong object is released from a blue tong-like holder into a tall glass of blue liquid, producing visible splashing and later settling.
raw_event_description: At the start, a tall transparent cylindrical glass stands on a wooden surface with blue liquid in its lower portion and a green band around the outside near the liquid level. A brown oblong solid is held at the top opening by a blue tong-like tool and remains nearly still for many frames. Later the brown object moves downward into the glass, enters the blue liquid, and becomes submerged near the lower right area of the glass. The liquid surface becomes disturbed with waves and splashes, then the motion of the surface diminishes while the object remains visible underwater.

reasons: The glass, liquid, green band, brown object, and blue holder are visible before the main motion begins.
The upper part of the holder is partly cut off by the frame edge, but its contact with the brown object is visible.
